title: Giza pyramid stones may have been mixed and poured

tellings.quote: we might have poured the stones mied them and poured them

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a researcher who also wrote a book called The Ultimate Time Machine, suggests that the stones of the pyramids at Giza in Egypt may not have been cut and hauled. He says the builders might have mixed the stone material and poured it into shape, which if true would change how we think the pyramids were built.
